entities.name: Zdeňka Veřmiřovská
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdeňka Veřmiřovská was a Czech gymnast. She represented Czechoslovakia in the 1936 Summer Olympics receiving silver in the team event, and in the 1948 Summer Olympics winning gold in the team event. She was born on 27 June 1913 in Kopřivnice and died on 13 May 1997 in Prague.
